title: Lavender / Users & data
description: Sign ins, registrations, what the users do, backups and the amount of data.

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Registered accounts.

panels.title: Logins (24h)
panels.description: Successful logins.

panels.title: Failed logins (1h)
panels.description: Wrong email or password. A jump can be someone trying passwords.

panels.title: 2FA lockouts (24h)
panels.description: Accounts locked after too many wrong two-factor codes.

panels.title: Action errors (1h)
panels.description: Actions that answered with an error toast.

panels.title: Logins by step and result
panels.description: step password: success (no second step), invalid_credentials, two_factor_required, invalid_request, error. step two_factor: success or error.

panels.title: Failed login ratio
panels.description: Wrong email or password, as a share of the password steps.

panels.title: Password check duration
panels.description: Hashing a password is made slow on purpose, a jump means the host is short of CPU.

panels.title: Recovery codes used
panels.description: A recovery code works once. A user who uses them is losing their authenticator.

panels.title: Registrations by result
panels.description: success, email_taken, weak_password, invalid_email, invalid_request, error.

panels.title: Two-factor checks by result and code
panels.description: success, invalid, locked, expired, invalid_request, error. The code is app or recovery.

panels.title: Actions by route
panels.description: Every action is answered with a toast, counted here by the route that handled it.

panels.title: Failing actions by route
panels.description: Actions answered with an error toast. They answer 200, so the http error ratio does not show them.

panels.title: Articles opened
panels.description: Articles opened in the reading panel.

panels.title: Articles saved and taken back
panels.description: kind favourite or read_later, state saved or removed.

panels.title: Articles per page (average)
panels.description: Pages hold at most 30. A list that stays well below that is nearly empty.

panels.title: Page loads by list
panels.description: home, today, favourites, read-later and feed. Includes the next pages when scrolling.

panels.title: Operations by type and result
panels.description: backup_export, backup_import, opml_export and opml_import.

panels.title: What was exported and imported
panels.description: Folders, feeds, articles, saved articles and icons.
